historical_significance: 马可波罗（1254-1324），意大利威尼斯商人旅行家，1271-1295年间穿越欧亚大陆到达大元帝国，成为少数到达中国的西方人之一。其行踪记录在《东游记》，为欧洲人了解中国提供了宝贵资料。他不仅是一位贸易使者，更是一位文化使者，记录涵盖政治、经济、文化、地理和风俗等多领域，打破了欧洲对东方的偏见。
historical_significance_en: Marco Polo (1254-1324), Venetian merchant and traveler who traversed the Eurasian continent from 1271-1295 to reach the Great Mongol Empire, becoming one of the few Westerners to reach China. His travels were recorded in 'The Travels of Marco Polo,' providing invaluable knowledge for later Europeans to understand China. He was not only a trade envoy but also a cultural envoy, with records covering politics, economy, culture, geography and customs, breaking many European prejudices against the Orient.
